description: A lace-booster that runs your wetware past the red line. Smoke may be metaphorical.

effects.onset_message: Your lace comes up to temperature. Thoughts arrive already finished.

overdose.message: Your wetware runs too hot for too long and something delicate inside simply melts.

phases.comeup_message: Your lace spins up with a whine only you can hear. The world turns to data.
phases.end_message: The clock drops back to baseline. Your skull throbs where the heat pooled.
phases.peak_message: You are thinking in parallel now, a dozen threads, all of them screaming.

withdrawal.message: Baseline feels like wading through mud. You want the clock back up.

name: Neural Overclock
